title: A Unified Model for Thermo- and Multiple-Network Poroelasticity with a Global-in-Time Iterative Decoupling Scheme
summary: This paper introduces a unified model for thermo-poroelasticity and multiple-network poroelasticity, reformulated into a total-pressure-based system. We first establish the well-posedness of the problem via a Galerkin-based argument and subsequently introduce a robust space-time finite element approximation. To efficiently solve the fully coupled system, we propose a global-in-time iterative algorithm that sequentially decouples the mechanics from the transport equations, while incorporating necessary stabilization terms.
